ops.oldText: Customer may terminate this Agreement (including all Service Option Attachments) or any Service Option Attachment (with the exception of any Service Option Attachment that is a prerequisite for the provision of Services under a non-terminated Service Option Attachment) for convenience at the end of any calendar month by:
ops.newText: Customer may terminate for convenience this Agreement (including all Service Option Attachments) or any Service Option Attachment (with the exception of any Service Option Attachment that is a prerequisite for the provision of Services under a non-terminated Service Option Attachment) at the end of any calendar month by:

ops.oldText: a. providing at least one month's prior written notice to IBM; and
ops.newText: a. providing at least 60 days' prior written notice to IBM; and

ops.oldText: b. paying the applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments.
ops.newText: b. paying the applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments, not exceeding 3 months' fees.

ops.text: IBM may terminate this Agreement or any Service Option Attachment for convenience only effective at the end of the then-current term, and only upon 90 days' notice in writing to Customer.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We made "Customer may terminate for convenience" operative, set Customer's notice at 60 days' and capped the early termination charges at 3 months' fees, and added one sentence stating IBM may terminate for convenience only effective at the end of the then-current term on 90 days' notice. This is our fallback termination-for-convenience position; the uncapped Attachment A charges otherwise negate the exit right.
proposal.summary: Complete the fallback convenience-termination bargain: 60 days' Customer notice, charges capped at 3 months' fees, and IBM convenience termination only effective at the end of the then-current term on 90 days' notice.

mappings.element: Early-termination fee not exceeding 3 months' fees.
Vendor termination for convenience only at the end of a term.
90 days' notice for Vendor termination for convenience.
